periods.time: End of Seven Stars first-round D-block
periods.summary: Shizuku wins her D-block first-round match without injury, completing Hagun Academy's perfect first-round advance.
periods.cause: D-block continues after Kiriko withdraws from her match against Amane.
periods.process: The volume summarizes that the remaining D-block matches proceed smoothly and Shizuku, the block's only B-rank fighter, fully displays her strength against her first opponent.
periods.outcome: Shizuku advances to the next round unharmed.
periods.aftermath: All Hagun representatives have cleared round one; Shizuku is positioned to face Amane before Amane can reach Ikki.
periods.significance: Keeps Hagun's tournament momentum perfect and sets up Shizuku's promised countermeasure against Amane.
